text:
Evan: quick heads-up — we saw a memory regression in embeddings-prod causing OOMs on a small % of requests. I built a hotfix image (stitch patch) with a bounded cache and want to push ASAP. Can we get expedited approvals to skip full canary and run a fast window?

DeployBot: [deploy-request] image=redwood/embed-service:stitch-2026-03-22-abc123 by Evan
Requirements: ops-approval, service-owner-approval, smoke-checks
Link: https://deploy/redwood/embed-service/requests/6971234567

Marisol: how small is "small %"? if it's user-facing we probably need at least a short canary.

Evan: ~0.4% of requests hit the path. Errors are tail OOMs, not data-loss. If we can do a 5m fast window with 1% traffic and close monitoring, I think skip full 30m canary is ok.

Priya: what are rollback criteria? need clear SLO breach or memory OOMs >0.2% in the window for immediate rollback. also need smoke commands listed.

Evan: rollback criteria: error rate delta +0.3% vs baseline OR sustained p95 latency +200ms. I'll post smoke commands.

Evan: smoke checks:
```
# quick smoke (run from staging k8s job)
kubectl exec -n prod embed-smoke -- curl -sS -X POST https://embed.prod/api/v1/encode -d '{"text":"smoke"}' | jq '.status'
# tail logs for OOM
kubectl logs -n prod -l app=embed-service --since=5m | tail -n 200 | grep -i oom
```

DeployBot: Bypass canary requested. Policy: requires 2 human approvals to bypass canary. Current approvals: 0/2.

OpsOncall: +1 from me for expedited window. I can own rollback if we see OOMs. :thumbsup:

Luca: as service owner, I want to review the image hash. Confirmed sha=abc123 represents the cache bound fix. +1 from me if OpsOncall is owning rollback. Note: block EU full-swap until we validate EU canary metrics separately.

Marisol: ok from me too. scheduling the fast window at 23:50 UTC (10m smoke + 10m ramp, then decide). Evan — please attach release note snippet and brief runbook.

Evan: release note snippet: "embed-service: fix memory leak via bounded KV cache; reduces OOMs in high-concurrency paths. Backported to 1.2.x branch; image stitch-2026-03-22-abc123." Runbook: watch p50/p95/p99 memory and error-rate, be ready to pin to previous image redwood/embed-service:1.2.7 if breach.

Priya: smoke run command I'll run at start of window. I'll post metrics links and a quick Grafana panel for error-rate, OOM count, and p95 latency.

DeployBot: Approvals recorded: OpsOncall, Luca. Canary bypass granted. Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-22T23:50:00Z -> 23:55:00Z fast window. Deploy link: https://deploy/redwood/embed-service/6971234567/exec

Evan: starting rollout now. pinging @Priya for the smoke run.

Priya: smoke run done, status: PASSED. No OOMs in logs, baseline error delta 0.02%. Watching dashboards.

Marisol: ramp to 1% traffic now.

Priya: 5m check: p95 steady, error delta +0.05%. No OOM events.

Evan: ramp to 10% for 5m.

Priya: 10m check: p95 +10ms, error delta +0.08%, OOMs 0. Marking as green.

Marisol: thanks team. leaving full rollout to the scheduled cadence. Will update release notes and close request.

DeployBot: Deploy complete. Status: SUCCESS. Request closed by Evan.

Evan: closing thread — thanks for fast approvals and owning rollback. If any regressions surface we'll pin to 1.2.7 and roll back immediately. :white_check_mark:
